bbmp_sclub: sclub_cr.cpp and common.h from github.com/creep-ltx/bbmp csrc/misc, commit 19d87098b3716156d80224d22dc49ca22884d1b7, unchanged.
License GPL-3.0-or-later (SPDX line in each file, COPYING). Written for bbmp in a clean room from a description of the format only
(bbmp docs/replayers.md, "Sound Club"). common.h declares the helpers (header, emit, fail, readFile) that bbmp-misc.cpp defines; the
Selecta shim defines them itself, so bbmp-misc.cpp (its other engines, CLI and downloader) is not vendored.
Not shipped: Sound Club for Windows 2.03's instrument bank (sclub.bnk) and FM waveforms (scwaves.bin) are BlueMoon's, distributable
only inside the publisher's whole package. Songs that name bank instruments are refused unless the user points $BBMP_SOUNDCLUB_DATA
at a folder holding both files; plain-sample and own-FM songs play without them.
